# Replacements 0.3.3
Pick a face. Choose your shortcut.
- New **Emoticons** section in the template library with 200 faces: a static snapshot of Messletters' Popular collection plus a favorite eyes face. - Larger previews and a simple setup form with an empty, focused shortcut field. Choose your own shortcut before adding a face to Apple's library. - Exact Unicode expressions are preserved, including combining marks, spaces and emoji variation selectors. The collection stays local and does not fetch updates from the website. - Includes 0.3.2's San Francisco icon, simpler library and visible save-failure feedback.
43 automated tests passed. The signed app's isolated demo flow was checked from searching for a face through choosing a shortcut and adding it. Universal Apple Silicon/Intel, Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled, with a signed Sparkle update from GitHub.
macOS 15 or later. Free, MIT licensed, no account or custom sync service. [Emoticon source](https://www.messletters.com/en/emoticons/).
